environment.description: Lambda function URL configured with AuthType=NONE, deployed in us-east-1. The function URL endpoint (https://<url-id>.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/decrypt) is publicly accessible without any authentication. No resource policy restricts access. The Go binary runs as a custom runtime on Lambda with the HTTP handler exposed directly through the function URL. Kafka consumer connects to MSK cluster in same VPC via ENI.
